name: Plaza Garland
summary: Plaza Garland is a vibrant multicultural shopping center in Garland, Texas, offering authentic international dining, specialty retail, and entertainment in a family-friendly environment. The center celebrates diverse cultural traditions with unique handcrafted items, traditional crafts, and restaurants serving flavors from around the world.
demographics: Plaza Garland primarily serves the multicultural Hispanic and Latino communities of Garland and surrounding Dallas suburbs, attracting families and individuals seeking authentic cultural shopping and dining experiences. The visitor base consists largely of middle-income households with children who value traditional products, services, and entertainment that reflect their cultural heritage. The trade area draws from Garland's diverse population, with shoppers typically ranging from young families to middle-aged adults seeking specialty items, international cuisine, and community-oriented services not commonly found in mainstream retail centers.
description: Plaza Garland stands as a vibrant multicultural shopping destination in Garland, Texas, offering a unique retail experience that celebrates diverse cultural traditions under one roof. Located at 3161 Broadway Boulevard, this community-focused center has established itself as a hub for authentic international shopping, dining, and entertainment, particularly serving the area's Hispanic and Latino communities. The plaza features a carefully curated mix of specialty retailers spanning fashion, health and beauty, and professional services, alongside restaurants that deliver genuine flavors from various cultures. What sets Plaza Garland apart is its commitment to creating a clean, family-friendly environment where visitors can discover everything from handcrafted items and traditional Hispanic crafts to local artwork and cultural products. Operating five days a week from 10am to 8pm (closed Tuesdays and Wednesdays), the center has earned a strong reputation with a 4.3-star rating from over 1,000 reviews, reflecting its role as a beloved community gathering place that offers both practical shopping solutions and cultural connection for residents throughout the Dallas-Garland area.
